statement.zh: 拉帕努伊遗产表述须优先社区管护与伦理，避免将摩艾简化为可随意复制的视觉商品。
statement.en: Rapa Nui heritage wording must prioritise community stewardship and ethics, avoiding treating moai as freely reproducible visual commodities.
